decision: Mapbox Terrain-RGB elevation data required only on OpenStreetMap physical land inside the Colombia OSM country relation, not on sea/ocean pixels; sea bathymetry is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE
OSM_physical_land_reference: OSM natural=coastline assembled land polygons, including islands and islets; other OSM place=island/islet points or administrative water cannot alone make land

one_partially_intersecting_OSM_colombia_.note: No mapped physical OSM land has been demonstrated in this offshore tile. The maritime/admin boundary intersects it, but that alone is not land. Strict pixel-level land exclusion from this tile remains pending local OSMCoastline land polygon verification; do not claim all 31232 pixels are sea.

study_method: Reused preexisting exact native/OSM pixel results; looked up single OpenStreetMap Colombia admin_level=2 relation 120027 and local OSM coastline/island elements in Tumaco bbox. No global OSM polygon archive, native COG raster, national DEM, foreign geoBoundaries or IGAC reruns.

land_only_terrain_rule.land_pixel: Pixel center lies inside a valid OSM natural=coastline land polygon AND inside OSM Colombia country scope
land_only_terrain_rule.missing_on_required_land_pixel: block export; never invent 0m or ocean depth
land_only_terrain_rule.outside_required_land: not required by DEM coverage; never count missing native NoData as a Colombian terrain defect
land_only_terrain_rule.no_land_tile: do not emit a Terrain-RGB tile
land_only_terrain_rule.mixed_coast_tile: must mask off-land pixels without writing fake elevation values; validate target renderer's NoData/alpha handling before release
land_only_terrain_rule.unverified_geometry: remain UNKNOWN; no guess is ocean or land

remaining_release_gates: Verify exact small local OSMCoastline physical land mask for the one partly intersecting offshore Tumaco z13 tile; no source recheck required.
Implement and test land-only PNG/MBTiles handling for ocean-transparent/masked pixels at mixed coast tiles and low zooms; never encode nodata as RGB(0,0,0) / -10000m.
Run land-only all-zoom output validation and TileServer GL/MapLibre terrain consumer compatibility, including islands/coasts, without repeated original source inventory scans.

additional_single_tile_review_2026_11_14.review: Remaining pixels visually verified as Colombia administrative border stroke and text, NOT coastline/land; prior OSM bounded query found 0 coastlines and 0 island polygons intersecting the tile
additional_single_tile_review_2026_11_14.note: Any actual land masks must be computed from assembled OSMCoastline polygons in the generator; do not assign the 31232 NoData pixels ocean elevations.

generator_initial_stage.current_capability: validated OSM-only FULL-LAND inward single/tile MBTiles; mixed coastal tiles fail-closed pending MapLibre-compatible renderer semantics
